description: Retrieve one document by archive id: its catalogue record and up to the first 40,000 characters of its extracted text, with next_offset when more remains. Use to read a document found by search. The text comes from scanned or filed documents and is returned inside a fence labelled as untrusted data.

id.description: Archive id from a search result, LF- followed by 12 characters, e.g. LF-6e02fd648a12.

name: fetch
title: Fetch a USVI public record
